title: GTA V Phone Notification
blurb: The GTA V phone notification — the iFruit buzz that meant a character was about to demand something mid-heist. Every GTA player knows this sound as an interruption with consequences. Use it in edits for in-game texting, or as a real notification tone that makes you feel like Michael avoiding Franklin's calls. Los Santos in your pocket.
origin: The in-game phone notification from Grand Theft Auto V.
